landing.heroSubtitle: Complete real missions, earn points on a transparent ledger, climb the leaderboard and unlock reward tiers — while building your personal brand.
landing.whatBody: Zyven partners with colleges across Tamil Nadu. As an ambassador you run verified missions — social posts, community growth, campus events — get your proof reviewed by admins, earn points and rise through Bronze, Silver, Gold and Champion tiers.
landing.howSubtitle: Five stages, one loop: Discover → Act → Submit → Verify → Earn.
landing.stage1Body: Browse live missions matched to your interests.
landing.stage2Body: Follow, post, join — guided step by step.
landing.stage3Body: Paste your post URL or upload a screenshot.
landing.stage4Body: Admins review proofs, usually within 24 hours.
landing.stage5Body: Points land on a transparent ledger. Rank and tiers update instantly.
landing.featuredSubtitle: Two live at launch. More dropping every week.
landing.benefit1Body: Every approved mission adds to a transparent, tamper-proof ledger.
landing.benefit2Body: Top ambassadors are announced publicly and featured on campus.
landing.benefit3Body: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Champion perks unlock as you grow.
landing.benefit4Body: A formal Certificate of Recognition for top performers — planned for this cohort.
landing.benefit5Body: Join a WhatsApp community of ambitious students across colleges.
landing.benefit6Body: Priority access to internships and events — fast-track consideration, not guarantees.
landing.faqA1: Any enrolled college student in Tamil Nadu. You register with your college email details and complete your profile in minutes.
landing.faqA2: No. The program is free; you invest time, we handle verification and rewards.
landing.faqA3: When an admin approves your proof, points are written once to a ledger tied to that submission. Double approvals can never double-award.
landing.faqA4: Usually under 24 hours. You will see the exact state of every submission in your timeline.
landing.faqA5: Tier unlocks: Bronze at 50 pts, Silver at 150, Gold at 300, Champion at 500 — with merch, certificates and opportunity fast-tracks planned along the way.
landing.faqA6: Yes — a college-vs-college leaderboard aggregates every member's points. Bring your campus up the ranks.
landing.ctaFinalTitle: The founding cohort is filling up
landing.ctaFinalBody: Be one of the first 100 Zyven Student Ambassadors. Your number becomes part of your story.
landing.marqueeColleges: MEC · KSR · Kongu · PSG · Sona · SRM
